Package com.pulumi.cloud.sdk

Class ApiClient

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.pulumi.cloud.sdk.ApiClient
  • public class ApiClient
extends java.lang.Object
    HTTP engine for the generated Pulumi Cloud SDK, built on the JDK HttpClient. Generated *Api methods build an ApiRequest and hand it to call(ApiRequest, TypeReference); this class substitutes path parameters, encodes the query string, applies authentication and headers, serializes the body, performs the request, and deserializes the 2xx response into the requested type. Non-2xx responses and transport/serialization failures surface as ApiException.

      • call

        public <T> T call​(ApiRequest request,
                  com.fasterxml.jackson.core.type.TypeReference<T> responseType)
        Perform a request and deserialize the 2xx response into responseType. When responseType is byte[] or String the raw body is returned without JSON parsing; a null type (or a 204 / empty body) returns null.

      • callWithHeaders

        public <T,​H> ResponseWithHeaders<T,​H> callWithHeaders​(ApiRequest request,
                                                                  com.fasterxml.jackson.core.type.TypeReference<T> responseType,
                                                                  java.util.function.Function<java.net.http.HttpHeaders,​H> parseHeaders)
        Perform a request and return both the deserialized 2xx response body and the response's headers, converted by parseHeaders — for operations whose response declares typed response headers. Kept as its own method (duplicating call(ApiRequest, TypeReference)'s body via executeWithHeaders(com.pulumi.cloud.sdk.ApiRequest, com.fasterxml.jackson.core.type.TypeReference<T>)) rather than added as an optional code path on call, so every other generated method's call site is untouched.

      • callWithHeadersOnly

        public <H> H callWithHeadersOnly​(ApiRequest request,
                                 java.util.function.Function<java.net.http.HttpHeaders,​H> parseHeaders)
        Perform a request and return just the response's headers, converted by parseHeaders — for a no-body (e.g. 204) operation that still carries typed response headers.
